items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Swift and all those different people that packed meat.

ctx.x: Yeah, and then the meatpackers were all downtown, Swift and all those different people that packed meat. So, between the trains and the stock market [sic: stockyards], everything was just – it was a lot of money brought into the communities, and it was a lot of work. Everybody was – that was one of the best periods.
Was a lot of this stuff controlled by mafia, a lot of those things?
